description: This Java class 'MockServerTestExecutionListener' extends 'AbstractTestExecutionListener' and manages the setup and teardown of a MockServerClient for test classes annotated with 'MockServerTest'. It initializes the client, injects it into test class fields, and resets or stops the client after tests.

classes.name: MockServerTestExecutionListener
classes.description: A test execution listener that manages MockServerClient lifecycle and injection for test classes annotated with 'MockServerTest'.

methods.name: prepareTestInstance
methods.description: Prepares the test instance by initializing MockServerClient and injecting it into annotated fields.

methods.name: setFieldValue
methods.description: Sets the MockServerClient instance into a specified test class field.

methods.name: getMockServerFields
methods.description: Retrieves or computes the list of fields of type MockServerClient in the test class.

methods.name: findMockServerFields
methods.description: Recursively finds all fields of type MockServerClient in the class hierarchy.

methods.name: afterTestMethod
methods.description: Resets the MockServerClient after each test method if applicable.

methods.name: initMockServerClientIfRequired
methods.description: Initializes the MockServerClient if it is not already initialized, using environment properties.

methods.name: isMockServerTest
methods.description: Checks if the test class is annotated with 'MockServerTest'.
